reviewScope: Independent semantic/source check of the 21 root-authored repair candidates only.

rows.englishSource: Voice note added — {name}
rows.candidate: Rhekhodo ya rito yi engeteriwile — {name}
rows.literalBacktranslation: Voice note added — {name}
rows.reason: Uses rhekhodo as the head noun for voice note, so yi agrees with the note; preserves {name}.

rows.englishSource: It's set up for students — not your role. Head back to your own home to keep going.
rows.candidate: Yi endleriwe vadyondzi — a hi ya role ya wena. Tlhela eka kaya ra wena u ya mahlweni.
rows.literalBacktranslation: It is set up for students — not your role. Return to your own home to continue
rows.reason: Retains the denied role condition. It does not change role into account permission; return-to-home instruction remains.

rows.englishSource: Progress could not be loaded or saved. Check your connection or account access.
rows.candidate: A swi kotekanga ku layicha kumbe ku hlayisa nhluvuko wa wena. Kambela connection ya wena kumbe mpfumelelo wa account.
rows.literalBacktranslation: Your progress could not be loaded or saved. Check your connection or account access
rows.reason: Explicitly says progress could not be loaded or saved and keeps both connection and account-access checks.

rows.englishSource: Save lessons to this phone before you leave signal
rows.displayCondition: Study learner page at app/student/page.tsx:1003; shown in the containing module/lesson/task state.
rows.candidate: Hlayisa tidyondzo eka riqingho leri u nga si suka laha ku nga na signal
rows.literalBacktranslation: Save lessons to this phone before you leave signal
rows.reason: Before leaving an area with signal is clear; save-to-this-phone stays explicit.

rows.englishSource: modules
rows.displayCondition: Study learner page at app/student/page.tsx:1014; shown in the containing module/lesson/task state.
rows.candidate: timodule
rows.literalBacktranslation: technical course term retained
rows.reason: timodule marks the plural with ti- and matches the term used in the accompanying modules-count candidate. Keep it as an unreviewed loan, not approved terminology.

rows.englishSource: You have completed the full ImbewuField permaculture curriculum. If you have a mentor, they will see this progress next time they check in.
rows.candidate: U hetile kharikhulamu ya permaculture ya ImbewuField hinkwáyo. Loko u ri na mentor, u ta vona nhluvuko lowu loko a tlhela a wu kambela.
rows.literalBacktranslation: You have completed the full ImbewuField permaculture curriculum. If you have a mentor, they will see this progress the next time they check in
rows.reason: The meaning and mentor check-in clause are retained, but the acute accent in hinkwáyo is unsupported by neighboring locale spelling; use the unaccented form consistently.
rows.recommendedCandidate: U hetile kharikhulamu ya permaculture ya ImbewuField hinkwawo. Loko u ri na mentor, u ta vona nhluvuko lowu loko a tlhela a wu kambela.

rows.englishSource: Lesson slides. Use Left and Right arrow keys to change slides.
rows.displayCondition: Deck UI at components/course/DeckPlayer.tsx:548; player is mounted only for a module with a deck, then control text follows current slide/player state.
rows.candidate: Slides ta dyondzo. Tirhisa tikhii ta miseve ya Ximatsi na Xinene ku cinca slides.
rows.literalBacktranslation: Lesson slides. Use the Left and Right arrow keys to change slides
rows.reason: Ximatsi and Xinene preserve left/right arrow direction, and tikhii ta miseve identifies arrow keys.

rows.englishSource: Narration language
rows.candidate: Ririmi ra nhlamuselo hi rito
rows.literalBacktranslation: Narration language
rows.reason: Uses the existing locale phrase nhlamuselo hi rito for narration; language selection remains clear.

rows.englishSource: Narration for {title}
rows.candidate: Nhlamuselo hi rito ya {title}
rows.literalBacktranslation: Narration for {title}.
rows.reason: Uses the established narration phrase and preserves {title}; no unsupported claim is added.

rows.englishSource: Narration could not play. Check your connection and press Play lesson again, or read this slide below.
rows.candidate: Nhlamuselo hi rito a yi tlanganga. Kambela connection ya wena kutani u tshikelela Tlanga dyondzo nakambe, kumbe u hlaya slide leyi laha hansi.
rows.literalBacktranslation: Narration could not play. Check your connection and press Play lesson again, or read this slide below
rows.reason: Preserves failure, connection check, the actual Tlanga dyondzo button caption, and the read-this-slide alternative.

rows.englishSource: The animation could not load. You can keep listening, read the slide, or tap Watch to try again.
rows.candidate: Animation a yi kotanga ku layicha. U nga ya mahlweni u yingisela, u hlaya slide, kumbe u tinya Vona leswaku u ringeta nakambe.
rows.literalBacktranslation: The animation could not load. You can keep listening, read the slide, or tap Watch to try again
rows.reason: Preserves the load failure and both alternatives; Vona matches the actual Watch caption.

rows.englishSource: Narration is in {spokenLanguage}. {appLanguage} narration is not available for this module yet.
rows.candidate: Nhlamuselo hi rito yi hi {spokenLanguage}. Nhlamuselo hi rito ya {appLanguage} a yi kumeki eka module leyi sweswi.
rows.literalBacktranslation: Narration is in {spokenLanguage}. {appLanguage} narration is not available for this module yet
rows.reason: Preserves which narration language is playing and which app language is unavailable, with both placeholders.

rows.englishSource: No narration will play. Use Next to read at your own pace.
rows.candidate: A ku nge tlangi nhlamuselo hi rito. Tirhisa Landzelaka ku hlaya hi rivilo ra wena.
rows.literalBacktranslation: No narration will play. Use Next to read at your own pace
rows.reason: Explicitly says narration will not play and points to the actual Landzelaka control.

rows.englishSource: Read this slide · {language}
rows.candidate: Hlaya slide leyi · {language}
rows.literalBacktranslation: Read this slide · {language}
rows.reason: Adds the demonstrative for 'this slide' and preserves the language placeholder.

rows.englishSource: Pause {title}
rows.candidate: Yimisa {title} swa xinkarhana
rows.literalBacktranslation: Pause {title}
rows.reason: swa xinkarhana marks a temporary pause, distinct from the locale's Yimisa stop caption; {title} remains.

rows.englishSource: Some slides remain in English where your chosen language is not available yet.
rows.candidate: Slides tin’wana ti ha ri hi Xinghezi laha ririmi leri u ri hlawuleke ri nga si kumekaka.
rows.literalBacktranslation: Some slides remain in English where your chosen language is not available yet
rows.reason: Retains 'some', English, and the condition that the chosen language is not yet available.

rows.englishSource: Regional deck download contents
rows.candidate: Leswi swi dawunilodiwaka eka slides ta ririmi leri u ri hlawuleke.
rows.literalBacktranslation: Regional deck download contents
rows.reason: The proposal loses the regional-deck scope and describes slides in the chosen language. Keep the source's regional deck/download contents meaning while leaving deck technical terminology recognizable.
rows.recommendedCandidate: Leswi deck ya xifundzha yi swi katsaka loko yi dawunilodiwa.

rows.englishSource: Slides + English narration and clips
rows.candidate: Slides + nhlamuselo hi rito ya Xinghezi ni ti-clip
rows.literalBacktranslation: Slides + English narration and clips
rows.reason: Preserves English as the narration language and keeps clips as an included media type.

rows.englishSource: The full pack includes available English source narration, animations and lesson images.
rows.candidate: Pack leyi heleleke yi katsa nhlamuselo hi rito ya English source leyi kumekaka, ti-animation ni swifaniso swa tidyondzo.
rows.literalBacktranslation: The full pack includes available English source narration, animations and lesson images
rows.reason: Uses the established narration phrase while retaining available, English source, animations, and lesson images.

rows.englishSource: facilitators & funders · wifi
rows.candidate: vafambisi ni vaseketeri hi timali · wifi
rows.literalBacktranslation: facilitators and funders · wifi
rows.reason: vaseketeri hi timali specifies funders as financial supporters, rather than generic collaborators; audience and wifi remain.

rows.englishSource: {count} files did not download. Tap Finish download again while you still have signal — the rest is already saved.
rows.candidate: {count} wa tifayela a ma dawunilodiwanga. Tinya Hetisa ku dawuniloda nakambe loko u ri na signal — letin’wana se ti hlayisiwile.
rows.literalBacktranslation: {count} files did not download. Tap Finish download again while you still have signal — the rest is already saved
rows.reason: Preserves the failed-file count, actual Hetisa ku dawuniloda button caption, retry timing while signal remains, and the already-saved remainder.
